# Photo Plus privacy policy

_Last updated: 26 November 2026_

<!-- Generated by tools/i18n/content/faq_en.py (the same words as the app's Privacy policy screen). Host this page and give its address in Play Console > App content > Privacy policy. -->

## 1. Who we are

This policy explains how Photo Plus (the app) handles information. Photo Plus is a photo and video app that works on your phone; you don’t need an account to use it.

## 2. In short

Your photos and videos are processed on your phone and are not uploaded by us. We don’t ask for your name, email or contacts, and we don’t sell personal information. Ads are shown by Google AdMob, and purchases are handled by Google Play.

## 3. Your photos and videos

Photos and videos you take, open or edit are processed on your phone. Photo Plus keeps them in its own storage on your phone (Projects) and saves them to your gallery when you choose. They leave your phone only when you share them to another app or save them somewhere yourself.

## 4. Information stored on your phone

Photo Plus stores your settings, language, projects, edits, saved setups, reward points and plan status on your phone. This information is not sent to us.

## 5. Permissions

Camera: to take photos and videos. Microphone: to record sound in Glide videos. Photos and videos: to open the ones you choose (on newer Android versions you can allow only selected photos). Notifications: to remind you about updates. Internet: for ads, purchases, the time and update checks. You can change permissions at any time in your phone’s settings.

## 6. Advertising

On the free plan, Photo Plus shows ads from Google AdMob, including rewarded ads you choose to watch. AdMob may collect your device’s advertising ID, IP address and information about your device and how you interact with ads, to show ads, measure them and prevent fraud. Where the law requires it (for example in the EEA and UK), we ask for your consent through Google’s consent form, and you can change your choice at any time under Ad privacy choices. You can also reset or delete your advertising ID in your phone’s settings. See Google’s privacy policy at policies.google.com/privacy.

## 7. Purchases

Subscriptions are bought and managed through Google Play. Google processes your payment; Photo Plus receives only the status of your subscription, never your card or payment details.

## 8. Time, integrity and update checks

To keep rewards and Premium time fair, Photo Plus checks the current time online by contacting Google and Cloudflare servers, and checks Google Play for updates. These requests carry only what every internet request carries, such as your IP address, and contain no photos or personal details.

## 9. Services from Google on your phone

Some on-device features (face and person detection) use Google ML Kit and Google Play services, which may download models and send diagnostic and usage information to Google under Google’s terms. Your photos are processed on your phone and are not sent by these features.

## 10. Sharing Photo Plus

When you share Photo Plus from Rewards, the app you choose receives the picture and words, and the words are copied to your clipboard so you can paste them. The link carries a tag that says it came from a share in the app; it does not identify you.

## 11. What we don’t do

We don’t require an account, we don’t collect your name, email, contacts or location, we don’t use analytics or tracking tools of our own, and we don’t sell or rent personal information.

## 12. Children

Photo Plus is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

## 13. Keeping and deleting your information

Information on your phone stays until you delete it. Delete photos and projects in the app, clear Photo Plus’s storage in your phone’s settings, or uninstall the app to remove everything it stored. Photos you saved to your gallery stay until you delete them.

## 14. Security

Your information stays on your phone, protected by Android’s app storage. Connections to the internet use encryption (HTTPS).

## 15. Your rights

Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct or delete your personal information and to object to its use. Because Photo Plus keeps your information on your phone, you can exercise most of these rights directly in the app and your phone’s settings; for advertising, use Ad privacy choices or contact Google. For anything else, contact us.

## 16. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy as Photo Plus changes. The date at the top shows the latest version; important changes will be shown in the app.

## 17. Contact us

Questions about privacy? Contact us through the developer contact on Photo Plus’s Google Play page.
